crowdfunding.title: Paris is conquered. What's next?
paris: In April 2026, a small crew from Svrčuge set off in a convoy of old Renault 4 cars, headed for Paris. **Eleven people and over 5,000 kilometers**, from 16 to 29 April, with one goal: to make a village of just **five inhabitants** heard all across Europe.

And heard it was. The "Light for Svrčuge" campaign drew a huge response in the media and on social networks, funds were raised for the first phase of the lighting, and over 200 people welcomed the crew back in Herceg Novi.

stats.label: the trip to Paris and back

crowdfunding.nextText: Paris was just the beginning. **The next step is a crowdfunding campaign** through which we keep building the village: a children's playground, a small village market, a tavern and a space for events.
crowdfunding.intro: Crowdfunding means a large number of people each give a little, and together we fund what no one could alone. That's how Svrčuge already received the money for the light poles. We're building what comes next the same way.

crowdfunding.note: Our goal is to draw **the world's attention** to Svrčuge. And you, if you're one of our own, help the most by **signing up for the newsletter**, getting all the campaign news first and sharing the story onward.

storyPage.title: A Renault 4 to Paris: how a tiny village won over Europe
storyPage.lead: Svrčuge is a village in the hinterland of Herceg Novi with just five inhabitants and no street lighting. Instead of waiting, the locals and friends of the village set off in old Renault 4 cars all the way to Paris, so that **all of Europe would hear about Svrčuge. And they pulled it off.**

sections.heading: A village that refuses to disappear
paragraphs: Svrčuge sits in the rocky hinterland of Herceg Novi. Today **just five people** live there, and there is no street lighting. Even so, the village became known as the only one in the world that has its own website and social media accounts, yet no light along its road.

Out of that unusual story came the "Light for Svrčuge" campaign: the idea to light up the road through the village and to bring the community back together around one clear goal. It was not thought up by any institution, it came straight from the heart.

sections.heading: The road to Paris in the "little giant"
paragraphs: To carry the story beyond Boka Bay, the crew came up with something unusual: to travel to Paris in old Renault 4 cars, the "little giants" that drove these parts for decades.

The convoy set off on **16 April 2026**. Eleven people, a few old Renault 4s and support vehicles, and **over 5,000 kilometers** ahead of them. Along the way they visited the Renault factory in Slovenia and repaired breakdowns on vehicles that were several decades old. At one point a French mechanic handed them **a bearing for just one euro**, smiling that no one had asked for a Renault 4 part in twenty years.

sections.heading: Paris and meeting the diaspora
paragraphs: They reached Paris on 23 April. There they were welcomed by our people from the diaspora, those whose roots are in Boka Bay and around Herceg Novi. The story of a small village that crossed half of Europe in old cars moved many people and quickly spread.

sections.heading: A welcome to remember
paragraphs: The convoy returned to Herceg Novi on **29 April**, after **5,137 kilometers** traveled. **More than 200 people** came to the welcome, with applause, tears and pride. That day, a village of five inhabitants had a whole army of friends.

sections.heading: What the campaign achieved
paragraphs: The story of Svrčuge traveled across regional and European media, television and social networks. Donations arrived too, from Novi Pazar, Belgrade, Ljubljana, Istria and many other places. Funds were raised for the first phase, the lighting poles, and the installation is planned for the coming months.
The Municipality of Herceg Novi also lent its support. A documentary film about the whole journey is being made as well.

sections.heading: From light to life
paragraphs: **Paris was only the beginning.** The light is not the end of the story, but its first step. The next goal is for Svrčuge to become a small getaway spot: a children's playground, a little market, a tavern and a space for events.
That is why we are preparing a crowdfunding campaign. If you want to be part of what comes next, sign up and be among the first to get the link when the campaign starts.

status.title: The first phase has begun: lighting for Svrčuge
status.text: Thanks to the „Light for Svrčuge“ campaign, the funds for the first phase of the village's development were raised. With the money collected, **lighting poles were purchased**, and their installation and connection are planned for the coming months, **by October at the latest**.

story.title: How it all began: a journey to Paris for light in the village
paragraphs: Svrčuge is a small village with a big story. The first campaign connected the village, Paris and one simple idea, that the village deserves light.
People joined in. Locals, the diaspora and friends of the village showed that a community can do something concrete when it gathers around a clear goal.
Funds were raised for the lighting poles. It was proof that Svrčuge can be brought back to life.
But light is not the end. Light is the first chapter of this story, not the last.

vision.title: A new little getaway spot for Herceg Novi
vision.text: The goal isn't just to build a few structures. The goal is for Svrčuge to become a place where people can come for a day out, bring their children, buy a homemade product, attend a small event and **feel that the village is alive again**.
vision.highlight: We're not just building structures. We're building a reason for people to come back.

firstCircle.title: Join the first circle of Svrčuge friends
firstCircle.text: Before we launch the crowdfunding campaign, we're gathering people who want to be **the first to get the link, the first to share the story and the first to help** give the campaign momentum.
firstCircle.subtext: You don't have to wait until you can donate a lot. When the campaign starts, even **a symbolic donation of 5€, a coffee for Svrčuge**, can help the story get going, spread and reach bigger donors.

coffee.title: One coffee can give the whole campaign a push
coffee.text: When the crowdfunding campaign is live, the first days will matter most. If many people support the campaign even symbolically, it gains momentum, trust and a better chance of reaching bigger donors.
coffee.text2: That's why we'll invite friends of Svrčuge to donate at least **5€** on the first day, **a coffee for Svrčuge**, and share the campaign with their people.
coffee.highlight: Sharing the campaign is worth almost as much as a donation.

partners.text: If you're a company, organization, embassy, foundation or institution that supports local development, culture, family, sustainable tourism or the preservation of villages, Svrčuge can be a small but visible project with great social significance.

items.q: Why are you collecting email addresses?
items.a: So that, before the crowdfunding campaign, we can gather people who want to be the first to get the link, support the campaign and help spread the story.

items.q: Why does a small 5€ donation matter?
items.a: Because many small donations on the first day can help the campaign gain momentum, trust and greater visibility.
A symbolic donation of 5€ when the crowdfunding campaign starts. It's not a big amount for one person, but it can mean a lot if a large number of people join in.

items.q: What is the Honorary ID card of Svrčuge?
items.a: A personalized digital thank-you for friends of the project. It's not a legal document, but a symbol of belonging and gratitude.

items.q: Will it be possible to donate from abroad?
items.a: Yes, the goal is for the crowdfunding campaign to be accessible to people from the diaspora and to international donors too.

items.q: How can I help besides with money?
items.a: You can share the campaign, connect us with sponsors, suggest funds or embassies, help with materials, equipment, media support or volunteering.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how the Svrčuge project collects and uses personal data you leave through forms on this site.

privacy.p_why: We use your email address solely to notify you when the crowdfunding campaign launches and to occasionally send important project updates. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.p_consent: We store data based on your consent, given by checking the box on the form. You can unsubscribe at any time via the link at the bottom of any email, or write to us at
privacy.p_retention: We store data for as long as the project lasts or until you request deletion. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.
privacy.p_contact: For all privacy questions, write to us at

terms.p_status: Phase one (lighting) is funded and underway. The lamp posts have been purchased and installation is planned for October at the latest. Future phases depend on the success of the upcoming crowdfunding campaign and the organisers' capacity.
